mapper.select: SELECT oi.product_id as productId, oi.product_name as productName, SUM(oi.quantity) as totalQuantity, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as totalAmount FROM tb_order_item oi JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.product_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
